scenes.say: Ever wondered why engineers are switching to Poetry or uv for Python projects? What makes these tools stand out?

scenes.label: Poetry
scenes.sub: Handles dependencies, virtual environments, and publishing with one config.
scenes.say: Poetry manages dependencies, virtual environments, and package publishing, all from a single configuration file.
Both Poetry and uv use pyproject.toml for setup and generate lock files for reproducible installs. Poetry focuses on publishing, uv is super fast.

scenes.title: Poetry & uv in action
scenes.say: Initialize a project, add dependencies, or install from a requirements file with locking. These commands make setup and installs simple.

scenes.question: What's the big advantage of lock files?
scenes.right: Lock files pin exact versions, preventing conflicts and ensuring reproducible environments.
scenes.say: If asked about lock files, remember: they guarantee consistent environments by pinning exact dependency versions.
